key_insight: The ScoreCard Toolkit evaluates synthetic medical imaging data beyond visual fidelity, revealing anatomical, distributional, and metadata-related quality issues.
clinical_relevance: Broader quality checks may help researchers identify synthetic-data weaknesses that could affect medical imaging AI development and testing.
method: Operationalizes six dimensions: Congruence, Coverage, Completeness, Consistency, Constraint, and Comprehension.
Combines preprocessing, feature extraction, metric computation, visualization, and structured scorecards.
Supports appearance, texture, and shape features, with extensibility to additional representations.
evidence_signal: Demonstrations on synthetic pathology patches, mammography, and head CT revealed dataset-specific distributional biases and coverage gaps.
watch_item: The abstract reports no quantitative validation linking scorecard findings to downstream model performance or clinical outcomes.
paper_title: Beyond Fidelity: Evaluating Synthetic Medical Imaging Data
